correctness.rationale: Reconstructed normalized weighted disk moments m_j=j!/(beta)_j, the exact fourth norm H+4m2 Re(b² conjugate(a c)), and its sign flip. The optimization over nonzero magnitudes reduces to AM-GM minimization in x and then the strictly convex coercive function F_beta(s). Strict convexity proves the unique global optimizer and complete phase and sign equality classes. Each F coefficient increases with beta, so the minimum grows strictly. Uniform coercivity and coefficient convergence prove both endpoint limits. The package checker passed 1080 finite assertions, including exact rational moment and sign averages; these are only diagnostics, not the proof.

value.rationale: Non-Hilbertian Bergman coefficient randomization and unconditionality are natural motivated analytic-function invariants. Degree two is the first polynomial cutoff where a three-term additive frequency relation changes the fourth norm under a sign flip; all two-term spaces are sign-isometric. Exact sharp norm, complete extremizers, strictly monotone weight law and nontrivial Gaussian limiting constant form a genuine all-parameter classification, not a generic algebra exercise or arbitrary sample.
